verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents its own registered agent service in all 50 states, and that role is what receives service of process. However, the evidence never mentions service of process, a physical street office for the agent, or scanning legal documents into the account. The separate mail-scanning feature belongs to the business-address plan and is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit service-of-process handling, a documented physical street office for the registered agent, same-day scanning and upload of served documents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received
